an4.193:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an4.193:1.2: atha kho bhaddiyo licchavi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho bhaddiyo licchavi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
an4.193:2.2: māyāvī samaṇo gotamo āvaṭṭanīmāyaṃ jānāti, yāya aññatitthiyānaṃ sāvake āvaṭṭetīti.
an4.193:2.4: “māyāvī samaṇo gotamo āvaṭṭanīmāyaṃ jānāti, yāya aññatitthiyānaṃ sāvake āvaṭṭetī”ti. kacci te bhante bhagavato vuttavādino, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaronti, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati? anabbhakkhātukāmā hi mayaṃ bhante bhagavantanti.
an4.193:3.1: etha tumhe bhaddiya, mā anussavena, mā paramparāya, mā itikirāya, mā piṭakasampadānena, mā takkahetu, mā nayahetu, mā ākāraparivitakkena, mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā, mā bhabbarūpatāya, mā samaṇo no garūti.
an4.193:3.3: ime dhammā akusalā, ime dhammā sāvajjā, ime dhammā viññūgarahitā, ime dhammā samattā samādinnā ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattantīti. atha tumhe bhaddiya pajaheyyātha.
an4.193:4.2: lobho purisassa ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati hitāya vā ahitāya vāti?
an4.193:4.4: luddho panāyaṃ bhaddiya, purisapuggalo lobhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto pāṇampi hanti, adinnampi ādiyati, paradārampi gacchati, musāpi bhaṇati, parampi tathattāya samādapeti. yaṃ sa hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti?
an4.193:5.2: doso purisassa …pe… moho purisassa …pe… sārambho purisassa ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati hitāya vā ahitāya vāti?
an4.193:5.4: sārambho panāyaṃ bhaddiya, purisapuggalo sārambhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto pāṇampi hanti, adinnampi ādiyati, paradārampi gacchati, musāpi bhaṇati, parampi tathattāya samādapeti. yaṃ sa hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti.
an4.193:6.1: taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhaddiya, ime dhammā kusalā vā akusalā vāti?
an4.193:6.7: samattā samādinnā ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti, no vā
an4.193:7.1: iti kho bhaddiya, yaṃ taṃ te avocumha :
an4.193:7.2: etha tumhe bhaddiya, mā anussavena, mā paramparāya, mā itikirāya, …pe…
an4.193:7.4: ime dhammā akusalā ime dhammā sāvajjā ime dhammā viññūgarahitā ime dhammā samattā samādinnā ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti. atha tumhe bhaddiya, pajaheyyāthāti
an4.193:7.5: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an4.193:8.1: etha tumhe bhaddiya, māanussavena mā paramparāya mā itikirāya mā piṭakasampadānena mā takkahetu mā nayahetu mā ākāraparivitakkena mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā mā bhabbarūpatāya mā samaṇo no garūti.
an4.193:8.3: ime dhammā kusalā, ime dhammā anavajjā, ime dhammā viññūppasatthā, ime dhammā samattā samādinnā hitāya sukhāya saṃvattantīti atha tumhe bhaddiya, upasampajja vihareyyātha.
an4.193:9.2: alobho purisassa ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati hitāya vā ahitāya vāti?
an4.193:9.4: aluddho panāyaṃ bhaddiya, purisapuggalo lobhena anabhibhūto apariyādinnacitto neva pāṇaṃ hanti, na adinnaṃ ādiyati. na paradāraṃ gacchati. na musā bhaṇati. parampi tathattāya samādapeti. yaṃ sa hoti dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti?
an4.193:10.1: taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhaddiya, adoso purisassa …pe… amoho purisassa …pe… asārambho purisassa ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati hitāya vā ahitāya vāti?
an4.193:10.3: asārambho panāyaṃ bhaddiya, purisapuggalo sārambhena anabhibhūto apariyādinnacitto neva pāṇaṃ hanti, na adinnaṃ ādiyati, na paradāraṃ gacchati, na musā bhaṇati , parampi tathattāya samādapeti yaṃ sa hoti dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya saṃvattatīti?
an4.193:11.1: taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhaddiya, ime dhammā kusalā vā akusalā vāti?
an4.193:11.7: samattā samādinnā hitāya sukhāya saṃvattanti, no vā
an4.193:11.9: samattā bhante samādinnā hitāya sukhāya saṃvattanti.
an4.193:12.2: “etha tumhe bhaddiya, mā anussavena mā paramparāya mā itikirāya mā piṭakasampadānena mā takkahetu mā nayahetu mā ākāraparivitakkena mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā mā bhabbarūpatāya mā samaṇo no garūti.”
an4.193:12.4: ime dhammā anavajjā ime dhammā viññuppasatthā ime dhammā samattā samādinnā hitāya sukhāya saṃvattantīti”. atha tumhe bhaddiya, upasampajja vihareyyāthā”ti
an4.193:12.5: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an4.193:13.1: ye kho te bhaddiya, loke santo sappurisā, te sāvakaṃ evaṃ samādapenti :
an4.193:13.2: ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa, lobhaṃ vineyya vineyya viharāhi.
an4.193:13.3: lobhaṃ vineyya vineyya viharanto na lobhajaṃ kammaṃ karissasi, kāyena vācā manasā.
an4.193:13.5: dosaṃ vineyya vineyya viharanto na dosajaṃ kammaṃ karissasi kāyena vācā manasā.
an4.193:13.7: mohaṃ vineyya vineyya viharanto na mohajaṃ kammaṃ karissasi kāyena vācā manasā.
an4.193:13.9: sārambhaṃ vineyya vineyya viharanto na sārambhajaṃ kammaṃ karissasi kāyena vācā manasāti.
an4.193:14.1: evaṃ vutte bhaddiyo licchavi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
an4.193:14.2: abhikkantaṃ bhante …pe… upāsakaṃ maṃ bhante bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
an4.193:15.1: api nu tāhaṃ bhaddiya, evaṃ avacaṃ:
an4.193:15.5: evaṃ vādiṃ kho maṃ bhaddiya evamakkhāyiṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhanti :
an4.193:15.6: māyāvī samaṇo gotamo āvattanīmāyaṃ jānāti yāya aññatitthiyānaṃ sāvake āvaṭṭetīti.
an4.193:15.9: piyā me bhante ñātisālohitā imāya āvaṭṭaniyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ. piyānampi me assa ñātisālohitānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
an4.193:15.10: sabbe cepi bhante khattiyā imāya āvaṭṭaniyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ, sabbesampassa khattiyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
an4.193:15.11: sabbe cepi bhante brāhmaṇā …pe… vessā …pe… suddā imāya āvaṭṭaniyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ, sabbesampassa suddānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
an4.193:16.2: sabbecepi bhaddiya, khattiyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ akusaladhammappahānāya kusaladhammūpasampadāya, sabbesampassa khattiyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
an4.193:16.3: sabbe cepi bhaddiya brāhmaṇā …pe… vessā …pe… suddā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ akusaladhammappahānāya kusaladhammūpasampadāya, sabbesampassa suddānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
an4.193:16.4: sadevako cepi bhaddiya loko samārako sabrahmako, sassamaṇabrāhmaṇī pajā sadevamanussā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ akusaladhammappahānāya kusaladhammūpasampadāya, sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
an4.193:16.5: ime cepi bhaddiya mahāsālā imāya āvaṭṭaniyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ akusaladhammappahānāya kusaladhammūpasampadāya. imesampassa mahāsālānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya sace ceteyyuṃ.
